title: Implement test mode with fake database
description:
Test mode implemented via existing features.

## Implementation

Two mechanisms provide safe testing without affecting real pebbles data:

1. **PEBBLES_DB_PATH environment variable**
   - Redirects pebbles to use custom database location
   - Usage: `PEBBLES_DB_PATH=/tmp/test-db pebbles <command>`
   - Implemented in Storage::new() (src/storage.rs:18) and JJ::new() (src/jj.rs:15)

2. **.no_jj marker file**
   - Place .no_jj file in .pebbles/ directory to skip all jj operations
   - Prevents commits, branches, and version control operations
   - Implemented in JJ::should_skip_jj() (src/jj.rs:37-40)
   - Used in JJ::commit() (src/jj.rs:68) to skip when marker present

## Usage Examples

**Temporary test database:**
```bash
mkdir -p /tmp/test-pebbles/.pebbles
touch /tmp/test-pebbles/.pebbles/.no_jj
PEBBLES_DB_PATH=/tmp/test-pebbles/.pebbles pebbles init
PEBBLES_DB_PATH=/tmp/test-pebbles/.pebbles pebbles new "Test issue"
```

**In automated tests (trycmd):**
- trycmd copies .in/ directory to temp directory
- Sets CWD to temp directory
- .no_jj marker in fixtures prevents jj operations
- Tests run in complete isolation

## Benefits Achieved

✅ Safe experimentation with commands
✅ Automated test suites for pebbles itself (tests/workflows/)
✅ Testing of scripts that use pebbles
✅ Training and demos without polluting real data
✅ Clean isolation between test and production data
✅ Works with all commands (new, update, delete, link, etc.)

## Note

No visual indicator implemented for test mode (not needed for automated tests, optional for manual testing).
